description: This modern and fully furnished professional house share offers a comfortable living space in a quiet yet well-connected area of Stockton-on-Tees. Located on Edward Street, the property is just a short walk from the town centre, providing easy access to local shops, restaurants, and leisure facilities. Excellent transport links make it a convenient choice for those commuting to nearby business hubs or Teeside University. The house features spacious, well-furnished rooms, each equipped with a double bed, wardrobe, desk, and plenty of storage space with your own en-suite bathroom. The shared areas include a bright and welcoming living room, a fully equipped kitchen with all essential appliances, and a dining area perfect for both meals and socializing adding to the overall comfort of the property. All utilities, including gas, electricity, water, and council tax, are included in the rent, along with high-speed broadband for professional use
